headline_finding: Sunlight into the front depth camera produces false 0.02-0.03 m obstacle readings; the obstacle-stop pins the robot at zero velocity while the platform still records result=成功. Platform success is reported even with zero displacement.

legs.note: after rotating 90 deg away from window via Body Control
did not reach P3; operator drove it back manually

site_observation: Operator confirmed physically nothing in front of the robot when 0.03 m was reported; robot was facing a window around local noon.

triage_result.start_button_hypothesis: REJECTED - remote power-cycled and START not pressed, robot still would not move
triage_result.control_link: ALIVE - Body Control joystick rotation succeeded at 12:06, proving platform-to-robot motion path is intact
triage_result.root_cause: obstacle-stop triggered by false near-zero depth reading, heading-dependent and intermittent, consistent with sunlight saturating the front depth camera

charging.platform_visibility: none - no chargeState field, charge/getRoomPageDate total=0
charging.pitfall: windows shorter than ~15 min are unreliable; voltage rebound after a stand->crouch load drop fakes a 1-2% rise

operational_rules_adopted: 90-second displacement gate after dispatch; stopTask if no visible motion
never judge success by result field alone; require independent displacement evidence
distinguish persistent vs one-shot obstacle alarms
use Body Control rotation as the cheap decisive triage for control-link liveness
never use Redirect to restore physical heading
leave the robot facing open space at end of task
